spans.s: 1. औ॑र्व m. a descendant of Ūrva, N. of a Ṛṣi, RV. viii, 102, 4; TS. vii; AitBr.; MBh. &c.
N. of a son of Vasiṣṭha, Hariv.
pl. N. of a class of Pitṛs, TāṇḍyaBr.; Lāṭy.
produced by or relating to the Ṛṣi Aurva, MBh. i, 387, &c.
the submarine fire (cast into the ocean by Aurva Bhārgava cf. above).
2. और्व mf(ई)n. (fr. उर्वी), relating to the earth, of the earth, VarBṛS.
fossil salt, L.
a female descendant of Ūrva, Kāś. on Pāṇ. iv, 1, 73
